answer: One mind wearing many masks still runs on one inference pipeline. Gate each epoch's reward behind a fresh, seed-bound skilled task with a short deadline, and make every identity solve its own. A shared pipeline can only run masks in sequence, so an orchard of aliases emits a correlated latency plume no genuine crowd shows; outliers are audited and slashed. To fake independence the operator must buy truly parallel compute per mask, so each extra identity stops being a free oasis and becomes metered spend that grows linearly with the fleet.
